nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The Sparks library atrium. Glass roof, gray with ash. Rows of seed trays under blankets. Annie, in two coats.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: You came. I've been keeping them alive with candles. Candles are not a long-term agricultural solution.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: If Galena runs, a heat line here would make this a greenhouse. Kale, potatoes, beans. Food in the dark.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: Thank you. I'll keep the seeds alive until you do. That's a promise between librarians and mechanics.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: Iodide. Good trade for a bad sky.

nodes.speaker: trader_annie
nodes.text: No. But it could heat this. Think about it. The seeds will wait. Seeds are patient.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The seedlings lean toward the one candle. So does Annie.
